title: Low life
wikitext:
[[File:Low life energy shield pool.png|thumb|Example of ''Low life / Energy shield'' builds. Most of the Life has been reserved by [[aura]]s.]]
'''Low life''' is a condition that applies when [[life]] is at 50% or lower. Linking [[Mana reservation|mana-reserving]] skills (such as [[aura]]s) to {{il|Arrogance Support}} which converts them into [[Life reservation|Life-reserving]] skills is one of the easiest way to maintain the low life condition.

Players that use low life will typically either use [[energy shield]]s to protect their health or {{il|Petrified Blood}} if they're not using energy shields. "LL" is commonly used to describe this type of build, which stands for "Low Life".

The only way to achieve Low Life while {{psl|Chaos Inoculation}} is allocated is with {{il|Coward's Legacy}}, as a maximum [[life]] of 1 counts as being on [[full life]].

The low life state unlocks several interesting aspects for a character, but can be difficult to maintain efficiently.

==Strategy==
{{See also|Guide:Maintaining low life}}

The advantages to maintaining low life:
*Ability to use {{psl|Pain Attunement}} passive skill that grants more spell damage when on low life.
*Ability to use {{il|Bloodthirst Support}} for attack skills on life-based low life builds.
*Ability to use many more [[aura]]s by using [[Life reservation]] in combination with [[Mana reservation]]
*Ability to take advantage of the damage mitigation provided by {{il|Petrified Blood}}, as well as being able to [[Leech#|overleech]] life if you have unreserved life over the low life threshold

The disadvantages while maintaining low life:
*Energy shield has fewer recovery methods available. It cannot normally be recovered through a life flask, and energy shield recharge can be interrupted by taking damage. {{psl|Zealot's Oath}} or {{psl|Pious Path}} is often used in order for life regeneration to apply to energy shield, or {{psl|Supreme Decadence}} and similar effects like from {{il|The Sorrow of the Divine}} allows Seething Life Flasks to instantly recover energy shield.
*Visibility in low light level areas is largely affected by [[light radius]], which is based on current percentage of your maximum life. Low life has a significantly reduced light radius due to often reserving 50~99% of their life. This can be mitigated by allocating the [[Energy Shield Mastery]] to make light radius based on energy shield instead of life or avoid running maps with indoor layouts.
*Energy shield [[leech]]'s maximum total recovery per second is by default capped by 10% of your maximum energy shield, which is half of what life has. {{psl|Ghost Reaver}} is often used to double maximum total energy shield recovery per second from Leech without too much investment.
*[[Stun]] threshold is normally based on maximum life. Because low life builds may neglect to invest in life, it can cause them to get stunned easier. Stun immunity or avoidance are often used in conjunction, or alternatively effects that alter stun threshold like {{il|Skyforth}} and the {{c|mod|50% of your Energy Shield is added to your Stun Threshold}} [[Energy Shield Mastery]].
*Builds which reserve nearly all their life are vulnerable to [[Culling Strike]]-like effects, such as the {{c|mod|Monsters Kill things with 20% or lower Life on Hit}} Remnant modifier from [[Expedition]].
*Chaos Damage always bypasses Energy Shield, outside of a few exceptions.

==Common sustaining strategies==
* {{il|Shavronne's Wrappings}} is a very common choice for low-life ES builds, as it forces Chaos damage to affect energy shield instead of life. If it is not used, any Chaos damage can one-shot players if they have a very small amount of life.
** {{il|The Ivory Tower}} is an alternative for builds that stack a large amount of unreserved mana (i.e. utilizing {{il|Archmage Support}}).
** {{il|Coruscating Elixir}} with 100% uptime using flask charge generators - such as [[Pathfinder]] passives, {{psl|The Traitor}}, and {{il|The Tides of Time}} - and/or increases to flask duration.
* {{il|Presence of Chayula}} is another common choice that converts some life into usable energy shield instead.
** {{il|Ghostwrithe}} provides a similar effect and can be combined with the above for a significant conversion of life to energy shield. Players would still need some way to prevent chaos damage from instantly killing them, perhaps from a layering of multiple damage redirection mechanics and a high Chaos Resistance value.
* {{il|Prism Guardian}} is often used in low-life builds to change the reservations of socketed [[Aura]]s to Life at a reservation efficiency benefit instead of a determent, unlike {{il|Arrogance Support}} - though this does come at a cost of the support gem's Increased Aura Effect, which is not insignificant.
* If Chaos damage is not otherwise redirected, {{il|Petrified Blood}} (or alternatively {{il|Progenesis}} with 100% flask uptime strategies) can negate some of the chaos damage from hits and have the remaining damage be taken over time. It does nothing for straight Chaos [[Damage over time]].
* Life [[Recoup]] is useful for hybrid-low life builds, as it allows recovering life from non-chaos damage hits, though not too reliable.

==Related items==
===Essence modifiers===
[[Essence of Hysteria]] adds the following suffix modifier to a helmet: {{c|mod|Socketed gems deal 30% more damage while on low life}}

===Unique items===
The list below displays [[unique items]] related to {{c|mod|Low Life}}:

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|where = 
   items.stat_text LIKE "%Low %Life%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Pain%Attunement%"
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Related passive skill==
===Base and notable passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%Low_life%"
}}
===Cluster jewel passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "%affliction%" AND passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%Low_life%"
}}

===Keystone passives===
{{Query keystone passive skills
|where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Low_life%"
}}

===Masteries===
{{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Low Life%"}}

===Ascendancy passive skills===
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%Low_life%" 
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%low%life%"
  AND items.description NOT LIKE "%blows%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}

==Miscellaneous low life benefits==
[[Flask]] prefixes {{ml|FlaskIncreasedRecoveryOnLowLife1}} <!-- Cautious--> and {{ml|FlaskInstantRecoveryOnLowLife1}} <!--Panicked -->.

}}

==Trivia==
Since [[version 0.9.6]], the player light changes to noticeably reddish over the 33% - 37% range{{confirm|3.14 change}} to make it easier to judge when the condition applies.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.21.0|
* Add a new [[Life Mastery]]: {{c|mod|You count as on Low Life while at 55% of maximum Life or below}}
}}
{{Version history table row|3.14.0|
* The Low threshold for Life, Mana and Energy Shield is now 50% or below (previously below 35%). This means that a single 50% reservation will now put you into a Low state. Light radius has been adjusted accordingly.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.6|
* The light radius reduction that occurs when on low life indoors has been changed so that it is more appropriate for players who care about the "when on low life" abilities.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.6|rel=before|
* Introduced to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
